prompt_text: Who is the best roofer in Denver for hail damage repair?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there isn’t a single objectively “best” roofer for hail repair — the right contractor depends on your location, insurance situation, the extent of damage, and which company offers the best combination of experience, warranty, and price. I can, however, help you find top local options and give a checklist so you can pick a qualified roofer confidently.

What to do next
- If you want, tell me your Denver ZIP code and I’ll pull a short list of highly rated roofers near you with contact info and recent review summaries.

How to choose a roofer for hail damage (quick checklist)
1. Get at least 3 written estimates. Compare scope (what’s being replaced), materials, timeline, and whether they’ll do a full tear-off or overlay.
2. Verify credentials
   - Proof of insurance (general liability and workers’ comp).
   - Local business license/registration if required by your city.
   - Manufacturer certifications (GAF, Owens Corning, CertainTeed) are a plus.
3. Specialization and experience with storm/hail claims
   - Ask how long they’ve handled hail-damage repairs and whether they work regularly with insurance adjusters.
4. Warranties
   - Ask about workmanship warranty and manufacturer shingle warranty transferability.
5. Read reviews & check complaints
   - Look at Google, Yelp, BBB, and local Facebook community groups for recent feedback.
6. Avoid common pitfalls
   - Don’t hire “storm chasers” who knock on doors after a storm unless you verify them thoroughly.
   - Don’t sign insurance checks to a contractor until you understand scope and permits.
7. Hail-specific questions to ask them
   - Do you inspect for hidden damage (attic, flashing, vents, gutters, siding)?
   - Do you install impact-resistant (Class 4) shingles or other hail-mitigation products?
   - Will you handle permits and final inspections?

Tips if you have an insurance claim
- Notify your insurance company early.
- Document everything: photos, videos, dated notes.
- Meet the adjuster and a roofer at the same time if possible.
- Get a written estimate and scope you can give to the adjuster.

If you want, give me your ZIP code (or neighborhood) and I’ll research 3–5 highly rated Denver roofers that specialize in hail damage and summarize pros and cons for each.
